mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 7.5% signal labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust supply-demand alignment, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST rise.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) erode corporate margins and trigger central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly change > 1.0%) reflects expanding economic activity that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 0.5% signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) combined with declining interest rates (FEDFUNDS) indicate strong consumer demand and accommodative policy, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS rises and FEDFUNDS falls.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO decline > 0.5% monthly) reduces industrial output and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 0.5%.
